about_the_game:
Two months ago, you fled the suffocating confines of your home with Lily, your adopted sister.

She's got a talent for leading you down the rabbit hole of booze and drugs, and a desperate need for your attention.

When Zoey was cast aside as the unwanted evidence of her father's infidelity, she learned early how people discard what they no longer want.

During their parents' divorce, Lily's refusal to run away taught Zoey that getting what she wants requires taking it.

Sarah, jealous of Lily's dependence on you, began a spiral of pranks to connect with her new sister.

While her intentions were originally pure, a violent incident involving your father left her emotionally shattered and bitter toward Lily.

One day, the house reached a boiling point, and Lily, breaking into your room, forced you to run away from home.

Will you be able to navigate all these human emotions, or will everything inevitably go to shit, as it always seems to do?

Features:

  • No common route, every choice leads to a unique adventure.

  • Multiple endings with dozens of meaningful choices and high replayability.

  • A story of family dysfunction and understanding of love.

  • Messed up characters, each with their unique brand of trauma and secrets.

  • Peel back the layers of psyches and uncover the disturbing truths that lie beneath.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is intended for a mature audience and explores complex themes that some players may find disturbing or uncomfortable. The characters, story, and situations depicted are fictitious.

The game contains references to alcohol and drug use, true crime references, depictions of dysfunctional family dynamics, and portrayals of unhealthy relationships. Some content may be triggering for players.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.4 (Holo) or later, or any modern Linux distribution (Ubuntu 20.04+, Fedora 36+, etc.)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Phenom II X3 or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 compatible with at least 256 MB VRAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL compatible

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.9 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0-compatible graphics card with at least 256MB VRAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard sound card

short_description: "Are We in Love?" is a dark, choice-driven visual novel that questions love and family. There are no butterflies in your stomach, only the harsh reality of a chemical sting in your nostrils and the acrid aftertaste of vodka. No common route. Fully branched story.
